now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#4
now.text: Betty Brant is the Bugle secretary who gets Peter back into the office to collect his pay. Peter has a crush on her and asks her to the Fall Formal, but she says no.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A young photographer with a crush on Betty.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Bugle secretary Peter has a crush on.

proposed.text: Betty Brant is the Bugle secretary who gets Peter back into the office to collect his pay. Peter has a crush on her and tries to ask her to the Fall Formal, but a tremor from the Shocker cuts him off.

changes.evidence: In Market Forces (#4) Peter tries, unsuccessfully, to ask Betty out to the Fall Formal when the Shocker's tremor rattles the city; she never answers. She turns him down as too young only in The Invisible Hand (#6), which is stage 1.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#9
now.text: Hammerhead accuses Norman of being the Goblin. The Goblin kidnaps him and dangles him over molten metal.

proposed.text: The Goblin kidnaps Hammerhead and tries to recruit him. When Hammerhead stays loyal to Tombstone, the Goblin uses him as bait, dangling him over molten metal.

changes.evidence: Hammerhead accusing Norman of being the Goblin happens in Reaction (#8), after Doctor Octopus is taken into custody. In The Uncertainty Principle (#9) the Goblin abducts Hammerhead, offers him a place in his ranks, is refused because Hammerhead is loyal to Tombstone, and hangs him over a vat of molten metal as a trap; it is Spider-Man who accuses the Goblin of being Norman.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#9
now.text: Desperate to impress Norman, Harry takes an Oscorp formula and becomes a Green Goblin.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Norman's son, whom he sees as a failure.

proposed.text: Desperate to impress Norman, Harry secretly takes Oscorp's Globulin Green formula. Found in the Goblin's costume, he collapses, and Norman takes him away to recover.

changes.evidence: Harry never becomes the Goblin: in Final Curtain (#26) Norman reveals he was the Goblin all along and found Harry passed out on Globulin Green, dressed him in the costume and injured his leg to frame him (stage 2 of this pair already says so). In #9 Harry is found in the costume, collapses, and Norman takes him to Europe. The new text keeps only what #9 shows, so it neither contradicts stage 2 nor spoils it.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
now.text: Otto runs the experiment that turns Flint Marko into the Sandman, then brings him into the Sinister Six.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Otto creates him, then recruits him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Makes the Sandman and leads him.

proposed.text: Otto brings Marko into his Sinister Six. Electro frees Sandman from Ryker's Island as part of Otto's breakout, and he fights Spider-Man under Otto's lead.

changes.evidence: The text retells the experiment from Competition (#5), which is stage 0. In Group Therapy (#11) Octopus plans the breakout with Sandman in it, Electro shuts off the security on Sandman's cell, and Ock leads the villains out to attack Spider-Man.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
now.text: Otto bonds Alex O'Hirn to the rhino armor he designed, then brings him into the Sinister Six.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Otto armors him, then recruits him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Armors the Rhino and leads him.

proposed.text: Otto brings O'Hirn into his Sinister Six. Electro frees Rhino from Ryker's Island as part of Otto's breakout, and he fights Spider-Man under Otto's lead.

changes.evidence: The text retells the experiment from The Invisible Hand (#6), which is stage 0. In Group Therapy (#11) Octopus plans the breakout with Rhino in it, Electro shuts off the security on Rhino's cell, and Ock leads the villains out to attack Spider-Man.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
now.text: Montana joins the first Sinister Six, which Doctor Octopus forms to destroy Spider-Man.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A member of Otto's Sinister Six.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Montana's leader in the Sinister Six.

proposed.text: Montana joins the Sinister Six, which Doctor Octopus forms to destroy Spider-Man.

changes.evidence: Calling it the 'first' Sinister Six gives away that the Master Planner rebuilds the team in Reinforcement (#16), a later title.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#10
now.text: Mysterio and the Tinkerer both work on the Chameleon's scheme to frame Spider-Man, and both end up arrested.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mysterio's partner in the frame job.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Tinkerer's partner in the frame job.

proposed.text: Quentin Beck and Phineas Mason both work on the Chameleon's scheme to frame Spider-Man, and both end up arrested.

changes.evidence: In Persona (#10) they are only the Chameleon's cohorts Quentin Beck and Phineas Mason. Beck first appears as Mysterio in Blueprints (#14), and Mason works as the Tinkerer for the Master Planner from there on, so the names are from later titles. The other #10 stages in this batch already use Beck and Mason.

owner_calls.question: Context stage 0 of this pair (not the checked stage) has the title 'The Spectacular Spider-Man' with no episode number, so it sorts before #10. Its text tells the Master Planner's new Sinister Six, which is Reinforcement (#16) / Shear Strength (#17). Should it move to The Spectacular Spider-Man#16 and be re-checked there?
options: Move stage 0 to The Spectacular Spider-Man#16 and re-check the text
owner_calls.evidence: The Master Planner reconstitutes the Sinister Six with Mysterio and Kraven in Reinforcement (#16), using an android stand-in for Beck.
